title: Honeycomb Ingest key (hcXik_, hcXic_): one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix: hcAic_, an uppercase type letter outside [a-z], prefix: hcik_ without the one-letter type byte, and prefix: hcxmk_ (the management-key prefix) with an ingest-key body; the management key is unclaimed. Twin of "Honeycomb Ingest key (hcXik_, hcXic_): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of honeycomb-api-key-bearer-header: prefix: hcik_ without the one-letter type byte. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
